meta.name: Detect AWS cost spikes and open Terraform fix PRs with OpenAI and Slack

parameters.content:
## Cloud-Cost Anomaly Root-Cause Auto-PR Agent

For DevOps/SRE teams. This workflow polls AWS Cost Explorer for daily spend, detects a cost spike against a rolling baseline, finds the most recent Terraform commit that touched the relevant infra path, asks AI to diagnose the likely root cause and draft a fix, opens a real GitHub Pull Request with that fix on a new branch, and notifies the team in Slack — fully autonomous, end to end.

### How it works
1. Runs on a schedule (or manually for testing)
2. Fetches AWS Cost Explorer data (daily, grouped by service) and computes today's cost vs a rolling baseline average
3. If the increase clears the configured threshold, it's flagged as a spike, with the top contributing AWS service identified
4. Lists recent GitHub commits that touched the Terraform path, picks the most recent as the prime suspect
5. Fetches the current Terraform file content
6. AI analyzes the spike data, suspect commit, and file content, and produces: a root-cause summary, a suggested fix, a fully corrected file, and PR metadata
7. Creates a new branch from the base branch, commits the corrected file to it, opens a Pull Request
8. Posts a Slack message with the cost numbers, root cause, fix summary, and PR link

### How to set up
1. Import this workflow into n8n
2. Add an AWS credential (with Cost Explorer / ce:GetCostAndUsage permission) to the 'Fetch AWS Cost & Usage' node
3. Add a GitHub API credential (personal access token with repo scope) to all GitHub HTTP Request nodes
4. Add an OpenAI credential to the OpenAI Chat Model node
5. Add a Slack credential to the Slack node and pick/verify the target channel
6. Edit the Set - Config node: repoOwner, repoName, terraformPath, baseBranch, costSpikeThresholdPercent, slackChannel
7. Activate the workflow, or use the Manual Trigger to test end to end

### Requirements
- AWS credentials with Cost Explorer read access (Cost Explorer API only runs in us-east-1)
- GitHub personal access token with repo (and workflow if protected branches) scope
- OpenAI API key (GPT-4.1-mini or above)
- Slack app/bot token with chat:write scope

### How to customize
- Adjust costSpikeThresholdPercent and the baseline lookback window in Set - Config and JS - Parse Cost Data & Detect Spike
- Point terraformPath at any file (EC2 module, ECS service, RDS instance, etc.) — or run multiple copies of this workflow, one per critical file
- Swap the Slack node for Microsoft Teams / PagerDuty for on-call routing on High-severity spikes
- Require human approval before merge by leaving the PR open (default) instead of auto-merging

## 1. Trigger & Cost Spike Detection

Set - Config centralizes all the knobs: repo, Terraform path, base branch, spike threshold, Slack channel, and the computed date ranges used by the AWS Cost Explorer call.

HTTP Request - Fetch AWS Cost & Usage calls the Cost Explorer GetCostAndUsage endpoint (daily granularity, grouped by SERVICE) for the last 8 days.

JS - Parse Cost Data & Detect Spike computes today's total cost vs the average of the prior days (the baseline), the percent increase, and which single AWS service contributed the most to the increase. IF - Cost Spike Detected gates everything downstream on that threshold.

## 2. Root-Cause Commit & AI Diagnosis

HTTP Request - List Terraform Commits pulls recent commits that touched the configured Terraform path. JS - Identify Root-Cause Commit picks the most recent one as the prime suspect (GitHub returns commits newest-first).

HTTP Request - Get Current Terraform File fetches the live file content (base64) so the AI has ground truth to work from.

AI - Generate Root Cause Analysis & Terraform Fix reads the cost numbers, the suspect commit, and the current file, and returns a root-cause summary, a plain-English fix description, and a complete corrected file, plus PR branch/title/body/commit message.

## 3. Branch, Commit, PR & Slack Notify

JS - Parse AI Fix Output & Build Payloads safely parses the AI's JSON, base64-encodes the corrected file, and carries the current file's blob sha forward (required by GitHub's contents API to update a file).

HTTP Request - Get Base Branch Ref reads the base branch's current commit sha, then HTTP Request - Create Branch creates a new branch from it. HTTP Request - Update Terraform File on Branch commits the AI's fix to that branch, and HTTP Request - Create Pull Request opens the PR against the base branch.

Finally, the Slack node posts the cost numbers, root cause, fix summary, and the live PR link to the configured channel. Every GitHub/Slack call uses continueOnFail so a downstream API hiccup doesn't kill the run.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ TimePeriod: { Start: $json.costStartDate, End: $json.costEndDate }, Granularity: 'DAILY', Metrics: ['UnblendedCost'], GroupBy: [{ Type: 'DIMENSION', Key: 'SERVICE' }] }) }}

AI - Generate Root Cause Analysis & Terraform Fix

parameters.url: =https://api.github.com/repos/{{ $('JS - Parse AI Fix Output & Build Payloads').item.json.repoOwner }}/{{ $('JS - Parse AI Fix Output & Build Payloads').item.json.repoName }}/git/refs
parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ ref: 'refs/heads/' + $('JS - Parse AI Fix Output & Build Payloads').item.json.prBranchName, sha: $json.object.sha }) }}

parameters.url: =https://api.github.com/repos/{{ $('JS - Parse AI Fix Output & Build Payloads').item.json.repoOwner }}/{{ $('JS - Parse AI Fix Output & Build Payloads').item.json.repoName }}/contents/{{ $('JS - Parse AI Fix Output & Build Payloads').item.json.terraformPath }}
parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ message: $('JS - Parse AI Fix Output & Build Payloads').item.json.commitMessage, content: $('JS - Parse AI Fix Output & Build Payloads').item.json.updatedFileContentBase64, sha: $('JS - Parse AI Fix Output & Build Payloads').item.json.currentFileSha, branch: $('JS - Parse AI Fix Output & Build Payloads').item.json.prBranchName }) }}

parameters.url: =https://api.github.com/repos/{{ $('JS - Parse AI Fix Output & Build Payloads').item.json.repoOwner }}/{{ $('JS - Parse AI Fix Output & Build Payloads').item.json.repoName }}/pulls
